summary: AgencyProfileHistory records and displays changes to agency profiles in the HSPnet platform. The system supports retrieval and formatting of historical change data, user identification and display, field-level changes, multilingual support, and integration into web UI controls.
purpose: To track and present a history of actions and changes performed on agency profiles including who made the change, what was changed, and when.

workflows.name: Retrieve Agency Profile History
steps: UserControl is instantiated with UserSession and AgencyID.
On data source selecting event, system checks for valid UserSession.
If session valid, input parameters are set for AgencyID, SessionAgencyID, session object.
AgencyProfileHistorySearch procedure is called in the database.
SqlDataReader iterates results and populates AgencyProfileHistory objects.
Results are returned and displayed in UI controls (GridView, Button, Label).

business_rules: If UserSession is null, data retrieval is cancelled.
When displaying user details, if ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID is not the original, display support team caption.
Fields may use alternate language if session specifies UseAltLanguageFields.
validations: UserSession must be present for history retrieval.
UUIDs for document lookup must match proper format.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: Format user display using initials and agency name.
ActionDateFormatted: Format date using DateFormatter utilities.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternate language field values.
system_behavior: Cancels selection event if user session is not established.
Formats and displays historical profile actions for an agency.
Populates UI controls via ObjectDataSource and GridView.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for authentication and session context.
Database and SqlDataReader for data access.
Resources for support team and multilingual captions.
exceptions: No user session or invalid session cancels history retrieval.
Malformed UUIDs are filtered during lookup.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for DB access failures present.
UI interaction workflow is somewhat implicit and lacks detail.
Details about persistence and audit logging are inferred, not explicit.
